# Pearce Packman

> Software Engineer based in the Baltimore/DMV area. CS student at UMBC and Software Engineer at Occams Group, building full-stack and AI-integrated production systems.

Pearce is a full-stack developer with experience in React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Azure, and AI integration (Claude API, Manus API). He worked as a mechanic and in construction before college, started in business/finance, then switched to computer science.

## Work

- **Occams Group** — Sole developer on OccamsRecruit (an AI-powered ATS live in daily use) and OccamsEnrichment (a contact enrichment platform). Built candidate scoring, resume parsing, and interview question generation with the Claude API, plus autonomous LinkedIn sourcing via a Manus AI agent. Wrote 500+ automated tests (Jest, Supertest, Playwright) with a full CI/CD pipeline.
- **DAMS Lab (UMBC)** — Research work presented at three UMBC research days.
